page.description: AlmaLinux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A community rebuild of RHEL 10, free of subscription gates, with a ten-year support horizon. Pick the boot, minimal or DVD image, then the architecture.
pros: Binary-compatible with RHEL 10, without a subscription.
Ten-year support horizon for the 10 series.
Boot, minimal and DVD images for x86_64 and aarch64.
Security errata follow Red Hat's, published as AlmaLinux advisories.
cons: Tracks RHEL, so software versions are conservative.
The publisher's own blog was unreachable here; the date is the mirror's file date.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for this page, so it is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for AlmaLinux in this pass; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One path per image: boot, minimal or DVD, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The release date is the official mirror's file date (2026-05-23); the project blog was unreachable to this client.
